abc.adoptionResearchNotes: Early-stage architecture and governance approach with no stable public adopter count yet.

adobe-content-authenticity.adoptionResearchNotes: Adobe publishes broad ecosystem updates, but AI preference uptake is not usually broken out as a separate public metric.

ai-pref.adoptionResearchNotes: Standards work in progress; public adoption is not yet well defined.

ai-ready-licenses.adoptionResearchNotes: License family is still proposal-stage rather than a deployed program with public user counts.

ai-txt.adoptionResearchNotes: Informal proposed signal with diffuse deployment and no canonical public adoption tracker.

bria-artist-program.adoptionResearchNotes: Official materials now support a partner-count metric for the licensed training catalog.

cc-signals.adoptionResearchNotes: Consultation-stage preference-signal effort with no stable public deployment metric yet.

cloudflare-anti-scraping.adoptionResearchNotes: Official rollout posts now support both customer-adoption and traffic-volume metrics.

commonsdb.adoptionResearchNotes: Public declaration volume is already recorded.

copyrightsh.adoptionResearchNotes: Public materials describe the offer and onboarding but do not yet expose a stable creator or customer count.

created-by-humans.adoptionResearchNotes: Author count is already captured from official materials.

credtent.adoptionResearchNotes: Official marketplace materials now support a conservative creator-count metric.

dappier.adoptionResearchNotes: Public materials make the product legible, but I could not find a stable official publisher or customer count.

dataset-providers-alliance.adoptionResearchNotes: Member count is now recorded as a conservative announced total across official alliance announcements.

defined-ai-marketplace.adoptionResearchNotes: Official 2025 review materials now support a conservative marketplace-revenue metric.

deviantart-noai.adoptionResearchNotes: Platform-wide feature adoption is hard to separate from overall platform scale.

do-not-train-registry.adoptionResearchNotes: Registry workflow is in flux and public counts are not clearly available right now.

easy-dataset-share.adoptionResearchNotes: Small OSS project without a strong public reporting surface for usage.

european-books-data-commons.adoptionResearchNotes: Design proposal rather than a deployed service.

fairlytrained.adoptionResearchNotes: Certification count is now recorded as a conservative rollup across official announcement posts; the undated certified-models page appears larger.

flexolmo.adoptionResearchNotes: Research-oriented commons effort with no stable public adoption unit yet.

gated-datasets.adoptionResearchNotes: Could be large in practice, but platform-wide counts would be inferred unless Hugging Face publishes them.

global-copyright-exchange.adoptionResearchNotes: Official launch materials support a conservative catalog-size metric; newer official corpus claims exist but are currently undated.

human-native.adoptionResearchNotes: Human Native has dated product and acquisition updates, but I could not find a stable public marketplace-size metric.

noml.adoptionResearchNotes: Proposal-stage directive with no canonical deployment tracker.

publishers-rights.adoptionResearchNotes: The coalition is now sourced, but I could not find a clean public member count worth recording yet.

robots-ai-directives.adoptionResearchNotes: Umbrella pattern spanning many actors; deployment is diffuse and hard to count cleanly.

rsl.adoptionResearchNotes: Official standards-release materials now support organization and page-scale metrics.

social-license-data-reuse.adoptionResearchNotes: Governance framework and toolkit rather than a product with obvious public usage counts.

spawning-data-diligence.adoptionResearchNotes: Developer tooling with no strong public reporting surface beyond indirect signals.

syftbox.adoptionResearchNotes: Open-source infrastructure project without a clearly disclosed adoption metric.

tdm-ai.adoptionResearchNotes: Emerging protocol, not yet a broadly deployed service.

tdmrep.adoptionResearchNotes: Community standard adoption is diffuse and difficult to measure without a dedicated survey or crawl.

tk-labels.adoptionResearchNotes: Local Contexts publishes broader program signals, but AI-relevant uptake is not cleanly separated.

tollbit.adoptionResearchNotes: Official launch materials now support a conservative premium-publisher count.

user-intents.adoptionResearchNotes: Proposal and demo stage, not yet a network-wide deployed control.

vaisual-marketplace.adoptionResearchNotes: Official materials now support a conservative image-corpus metric.

web-bot-auth.adoptionResearchNotes: IETF working group; adoption is not yet the right unit.

wikimedia-enterprise.adoptionResearchNotes: Partner and corpus-volume signals are already recorded.
